messages:
maya: Heads up — compliance sent a laundry list for audit exports. They want a clear immutable trail of who changed what/when + easy exports. Thinking about event shape + query UX. @sam @irene any quick thoughts?

sam: +1. We should decide early whether events are diffs or full snapshots. Diffs are smaller but harder to replay. Full 'after' snapshots simpler for queries.

irene: Also need PII redaction rules and field-level retention. compliance will want email/user id for traceability but legal may want names redacted after X days.

oliver: For the UX — consoles want to show a changelog per resource (route, quota, rollout). That means each event must include resource type/id, actor, timestamp, and a compact human summary. Query API should support filters by resource, actor, time range, and action.

maya: Agreed. My mental model: emit an immutable event per API call that mutates state. Keep optional small 'before' diff when helpful, but always include a full `after_summary` snapshot for consoles.

sam: Example shape (draft):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "ts": "2026-03-05T15:12:07Z",
  "actor": {"id": "user_123", "email": "dev@acme.com"},
  "source": "console/ui",
  "action": "update_route",
  "resource": {"type": "route", "id": "rt_45"},
  "before": {"traffic_split": 80},
  "after_summary": {"traffic_split": 60, "variant": "v2"},
  "request_id": "req_987",
  "trace_id": "trace_aaa",
  "reason": "canary rollout",
  "policy_version": "pv_3"
}
```

irene: Looks good. Add `redacted_fields` array for storing which fields were removed for PII, and `retention_category` (e.g., 90d, 1y, permanent) so exports can respect legal constraints.

jeff: On exports — customers want both ad-hoc S3/NDJSON exports and a continuous stream (webhook or event-bridge). Implementing both is heavier but required for enterprise. We should gate exports behind RBAC and quota checks.

oliver: For query UX, we should provide: 1) a time-series index for quick head queries, 2) a resource-centric index for per-resource timelines, and 3) raw export (NDJSON) for forensic teams. Consider ElasticSearch vs a columnar store vs event-hub + materialized views.

maya: Cost note: storing full snapshots for every change multiplies storage. Propose default retention 1y for most customers, optional extended retention for enterprise. Also add a dedupe/compaction job: keep full snapshot only for the latest per-resource checkpoint within a rolling window and keep raw events for audit-preservation.

jeff: RBAC: only org-admins + delegated compliance roles can request exports. Also log export requests themselves as first-class audit events.

audit-bot: auto-note: export-requested event created for org=acme, by=user_123, id=req_export_22, ts=2026-03-05T15:15:30Z

oliver: Implementation plan (short): 1) finalize immutable event shape (inc. redaction + retention tags), 2) proto query API (filters, pagination, per-resource timeline), 3) export endpoints (on-demand S3 + streaming subscription), 4) console integration (changelog panel + export UI).

maya: Next steps: I'll write an RFC draft with the sample shape and retention options. @sam can you prototype a minimal NDJSON export from current audit stream? @irene can you draft the PII redaction policy snippets for legal to review?

sam: Yep, will start today. I can throw together a small Lambda that pulls events and writes NDJSON to S3.

irene: On it. Will sync with legal and produce a short matrix of fields vs retention vs redaction.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-05T15:20:00Z: branch/feature/audit-export pushed to staging

maya: Great — RFC incoming by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
